dossier.public_summary: This dip is not steady. Early and late sectors show no or very shallow events while two events appear much deeper, and odd and even dips differ. The signal is driven by just two outliers at high significance. This pattern matches a blended background eclipsing binary or a non-planetary false alarm, not a planet on the target.

reasons.why: Depth not steady between sectors, far outside measurement errors. Verified with sector_depths_by_source: verdict changes_within_a_source with SPOC 2-min p_constant 7.126373160261464e-44 across three sectors, inconsistent with a planet on the target whose depth should be stable.
reasons.value: p_constant 8.589e-76 depth_change_pct 230.5 sectors: 1553±79 ppm S19, 370±116 ppm S25, 80±72 ppm S59, 142±84 ppm S79, 1983±121 ppm S86

reasons.why: Individual transits show extreme depth scatter. The whole signal is carried by 2 ultra-deep outliers; the other transits are absent or very shallow, inconsistent with a coherent planet transit.
